primer: NSE: IGIL is a debt-free certification tollbooth holding ~65% global lab-grown diamond grading share across 36 labs and 21 schools. In October 2025, rival GIA dropped granular LGD 4Cs letter grades, pushing global jewelers to consolidate around IGI's 4Cs standard. That shift lifted Q2 FY27 revenue +31% YoY and full-year FY27 guidance to 27%+. Business quality earns COMPOUNDER_PASS with 69.2% ROCE and 57.7%–61% operating margins, though the stock surged +38.3% in one month to ₹438.90 (Daily RSI 79.69). We assign WAIT_FOR_SUPPORT (₹375–₹395 entry, ₹340 stop, ₹520 base target for 2.27:1 asymmetry) and NOT_HELD.
